products.insurer_name: Europ Assistance Australia Pty Ltd (ABN 71 140 219 594, AFSL 552106)
products.product_name: Insure&Go International Single Trip Bare Essentials
products.pds_title: Single-Trip Travel Insurance Product Disclosure Statement
products.geographic_scope: International single trip. Select destination by main country/region; if spending >48 hours in North or South America select Worldwide Including plan. No cover for Antarctica. No cover for travel on Commercial cruise ships under this policy (separate Cruise policy required).
products.eligibility_rules: Available only to Australian citizens or permanent residents, or non‑permanent residents with valid Medicare, Private Health Fund or Overseas Student Travel Insurance in Australia. Applicants must be 18+ to buy; travellers must be ≤ the plan age limit. Age limits: Bare Essentials up to 79; Silver/Gold up to 100. Dependants under 18 can be covered when listed.
products.age_eligibility_notes: Applicants must be 18+ to purchase. Bare Essentials available to travellers ≤79 at application; Silver and Gold available to travellers ≤100. Full adult premium applies if dependants travel without parents/grandparents.

waiting_period_rules.section: General waiting period when policy purchased after leaving home
waiting_period_rules.trigger: Policy purchased after you have left your home to start travelling
waiting_period_rules.exceptions: Does not apply to claims that arise directly from an injury occurring after policy issue under Section B – Medical and Section C1 – Additional emergency expenses; no waiting period when buying a new policy as a continuation without a gap

products.policy_cancellation_refund_terms: Cooling-off: full refund within 21 days if no claim/rights exercised and trip not commenced. After 21 days, pro‑rata refund of the unused period less non‑recoverable government charges/taxes if no claim/rights exercised.
products.excess_options: Choose your excess at purchase; excess applies per insured person per event for sections marked Yes in the table.

excess_rules.benefit: General (sections marked with an excess in Tables of Benefits)
excess_rules.amount: As shown on Insurance certificate (chosen excess)

excess_rules.benefit: Benefits marked No in tables (e.g. Travel delay, Delayed baggage)

products.emergency_dental_limit: $500 (emergency dental for immediate relief of pain)
products.electronics_or_valuables_limit: Personal electronics sub‑limit $1,000; valuables limit No cover (per Table p39).
products.covid_cover_summary: COVID-19 cover limited to: medical expenses outside Australia (Unlimited) and repatriation/funeral sub‑limits; cancellation/disruption only when covered amounts are shown (Nil on this plan). No cover for government bans, border closures, quarantine unless due to your/the companion’s diagnosis, or for test costs.

optional_add_ons.name: Winter Sports Cover (Section N)
optional_add_ons.limits_summary: N1 equipment $1,250 (single article $600); N2 hire $50 per 24 hrs up to $500 (no excess); N3 lift pass $500; N4 ski pack $150 per 24 hrs up to $600 (no excess); N5 piste closure $50 per 24 hrs up to $500; N6 avalanche $600
optional_add_ons.conditions: Only when upgrade is purchased and shown on Insurance certificate. Winter sports activities as defined; additional conditions/exclusions apply.

optional_add_ons.name: Business Cover (Section O)
optional_add_ons.limits_summary: O1 business equipment $2,500 (single item $1,000; samples $1,000); O2 emergency courier $500; O3 equipment hire $100 per 24 hrs up to $1,000 (no excess); O4 business money $1,000 (cash limit $500); O5 replacing staff $5,000 (International only)
optional_add_ons.conditions: Excess applies to items marked Yes; terms per Section O.

optional_add_ons.name: Natural Disaster Cover
optional_add_ons.limits_summary: Extends cover under A (Cancellation), C (Additional emergency expenses – International only), and D (Travel delay: Silver/Gold).
optional_add_ons.conditions: Only when upgrade is purchased and shown on Insurance certificate; not for known events at purchase.

optional_add_ons.name: Additional Specified Items Cover (E2)
optional_add_ons.limits_summary: Domestic: up to $3,000 single item, combined up to $5,000. International: up to $4,000 single item, combined up to $8,000.
optional_add_ons.conditions: Receipts/valuations required. Not available on Bare Essentials.

optional_add_ons.name: Activities Plus
optional_add_ons.limits_summary: Covers listed higher‑risk activities (e.g., endurance cycling, >500cc motorcycles, certain tandem/altitude/scuba variants).
optional_add_ons.conditions: Sections F and G may not apply to activities marked with ~; must be with commercial operator for # activities; additional conditions apply.

sub_limits.parent_benefit: Medical and other expenses outside Australia
sub_limits.amount: $50,000 or up to €30,000 for Schengen countries

sub_limits.parent_benefit: Medical and other expenses outside Australia
sub_limits.sub_limit: Funeral or burial expenses outside Australia
Items stolen from a motor vehicle (per item)

products.limit_basis_notes: All sums insured are maximums per insured person per trip unless stated; some benefits have per 12/24‑hour sub‑limits.
products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Pre‑existing medical condition means conditions with treatment/medication/advice/tests in the 2 years prior to policy issue or consultation/referral in prior 12 months. No cover for pre‑existing conditions unless you complete medical screening and we accept cover for the declared condition with any additional premium; no cover for undiagnosed symptoms, travelling against medical advice, or terminal prognoses expected before policy end.
products.pregnancy_cover_summary: Cover only for complications of pregnancy and childbirth that occur before the 31st week. No cover for normal pregnancy/childbirth. Cancellation cover if you become pregnant after purchase and will be >30 weeks (or >20 weeks for multiples) at trip start/during trip, or if doctor certifies you are unfit due to complications. No cover for a child born after the policy issue date.
products.non_traveller_health_rules: Section A/C pre‑departure cancellation/Additional emergency expenses will not cover pre‑existing conditions of a non‑travelling relative/companion (unless specifically accepted). COVID-19 cancellation for close relatives only if life‑threatening diagnosis after purchase.
products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Covers only the excess charged under a rental agreement. Eligible vehicles include campervans/motorhomes <6t, standard passenger vehicles/SUV/4WD, minibus/people mover, motorcycles/mopeds with <9 seats. Excludes commercial vehicles, buses, trucks, trailers, caravans, vehicles with >9 seats, off‑road use, unauthorised drivers, breach of rental agreement, tyre damage (unless from a covered loss), wear/tear, mechanical failure.
products.luggage_conditions: Unattended property in public places excluded; valuables/electronics must be carried as hand luggage; items in unattended motor vehicles limited and only with forced entry and concealed storage; reports to police/transport provider within 72 hours (or as soon as practicable) required; proof of ownership required; IMEI must be provided and blocked for mobile device claims; depreciation applies per table.
products.business_cover_details: Optional Business Cover (Section O): Business equipment $2,500 (single article $1,000; samples $1,000); emergency courier $500; equipment hire $100 per 24 hrs up to $1,000 (no excess); business money $1,000 (cash $500); replacing staff $5,000 (International only). Depreciation 20% p.a. (max 90%) on electronics/clothing applies.

general_exclusions.heading: Pre‑existing medical conditions
general_exclusions.description: No cover unless screened and accepted; no cover for undiagnosed symptoms, travel against medical advice, terminal prognoses before end date.

general_exclusions.heading: Commercial cruise travel
general_exclusions.description: No cover under this policy for travel on a Commercial cruise ship.

general_exclusions.heading: COVID‑19 and epidemics/pandemics
general_exclusions.description: General exclusion for COVID‑19 and epidemics/pandemics except as specifically provided under Section M.

general_exclusions.heading: Do Not Travel / Sanctions
general_exclusions.description: No cover for travel to destinations subject to ‘Do Not Travel’ advice or where sanctions apply; cover cannot contravene trade/economic sanctions.

general_exclusions.heading: Financial default
general_exclusions.description: No cover for refusal/failure of providers to supply services due to their financial default.

products.travel_warning_and_sanctions_rules: No cover for travel in/to/through destinations subject to Smartraveller ‘Do Not Travel’ advice, sanctioned/embargoed countries/regions, or events in international conflicts/interventions; policy benefits cannot be provided where doing so would breach trade/economic sanctions (UN, EU, US OFAC, UK, France, Australia, NZ).
products.claims_process_summary: Register any claim within 30 days after completion of travel; provide proof of ownership/value and proof of event; police/transport reports generally within 72 hours. Excess applies per insured person per event where indicated. Claims can be lodged by phone or email; claim forms available online.
products.emergency_assistance_details: 24/7 Overseas Emergency Assistance Helpline: +61 2 9333 3999. Contact as soon as possible for hospitalisation >24 hours, emergency transportation, evacuation or repatriation. Provide Insured Person’s Name and Policy Number.
products.premium_factors: Destination and trip length, level of cover (Bare Essentials/Silver/Gold), number of travellers, ages, and selected options/upgrades/amendments (e.g., Winter Sports, Business Cover, Natural Disaster, Activities Plus, chosen excess).

source_evidence.quote: Single-Trip Travel Insurance PRODUCT DISCLOSURE STATEMENT. Effective: 29 July 2026. Insure&Go
Table of Benefits – International Single Trip; Domestic Single Trip

A Cancelling your trip $10,000 ... B1 Medical and other expenses outside Australia Unlimited ... Dental treatment $500 ... Return of body or ashes to Australia $50,000 or up to €30,000 for Schengen countries ... Funeral or burial expenses outside of Australia $10,000

C1 Additional emergency expenses $5,000 ... E1 Personal belongings and baggage $5,000 ... E1 personal electronics sub-limit $1,000 ... G Personal liability $1,500,000 ... H Legal expenses Nil ... K Rental car excess waiver Nil ... L Loss of income Nil ... M1 COVID-19 Expenses: Cancellation or trip disruption Nil ... M2 COVID-19 Expenses: Medical expenses outside Australia Unlimited
Items stolen from a motor vehicle $500 ... Valuables limit Bare Essentials: No cover
Waiting Period: If you buy your policy after you have left your home to start travelling, cover ... will be subject to a 72‑hour waiting period.

Eligibility: ... citizens or permanent residents of Australia or non‑permanent residents with a valid Medicare, Private Health Fund or Overseas Student Travel Insurance... Age limits: Bare Essentials ... 79 ... Silver and Gold ... 100 ... Applicants must be 18 years of age or over ... dependent children ... under 18 years of age

Cooling Off period ... within 21 days ... Cancelling your policy after the cooling off period ... refund ... proportion of the premium ... less any government charges and taxes that we cannot recover.
How to make a Claim ... You must register any claim within 30 days after completion of your travel.
No cover is available under this policy for travel on Commercial cruise ships. If you are taking a cruise you will need to purchase the Cruise policy.

This policy will not cover ... travel in, to or through destinations that are subject to “Do Not Travel” advice ... or where a sanction would prevent us from paying your claim (see ... General condition 15).
Natural Disaster Cover ... extends your cover to ... A Cancelling your trip ... C Additional emergency expenses ... D Travel delay ... upgrade and paid the additional premium.
Winter Sports Cover ... In addition to the standard policy benefits you will be covered for benefits under Section N – Winter sports cover.
Items ... Yearly Depreciation ... Phones, electrical devices...20% (max 90%) ... We will not pay any claim relating to a mobile phone ... if you are unable to supply the IMEI ... must be blocked.
Rental car ... vehicle types ... campervan/motorhomes under 6 tonnes; ... motorcycles or mopeds ... What you are not covered for ... unauthorised driver ... off road ... tyres ... wear and tear.
Any expenses incurred more than 12 months from the time you first received treatment for the injury or illness.

Section M – COVID‑19 expenses ... M1 Cancellation or trip disruption ... M2 Medical expenses outside Australia ... Important limitations – COVID‑19 ... no cover for government travel bans, ... border closures; ... mandatory quarantines ... except as specified.
